full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white pen drawing looks obliquely across a suspension bridge toward a dense city skyline. Two heavy stone towers stand in the middle distance, their tall arches cut through by the pale sky and distant buildings. Bundles of suspension cables fan outward from the towers in long diagonal lines, while the bridge deck crosses the lower half of the frame and recedes toward the far shore. In the near left foreground, dark girders, railings, and a staircase are packed into a complex web of straight edges. The broad river lies behind and below the bridge, rendered in quieter horizontal hatching; a darker stretch of water fills the right side. Across the river, narrow high-rise blocks cluster so closely that one building overlaps the next. Their rooflines rise and fall, with a few distinct pointed or stepped towers breaking the upper silhouette. Small rows of windows and structural divisions are repeated with patient linework, but atmospheric paleness softens the farthest buildings. The drawing is largely monochrome, using dense crosshatching and stippled darks for the bridge and foreground, then lighter thin lines for distant architecture. Even daylight gives the scene a broad readable clarity rather than a dramatic shadow pattern. The viewpoint is high enough to see the deck and river simultaneously, yet the towers dominate the central structure. The composition balances the bridge's precise engineering geometry against the packed, irregular rhythm of the skyline, making the whole image feel both meticulously surveyed and expansive.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白钢笔画斜向越过一座吊桥，望向密集的城市天际线。两座厚重石塔立于中景，高拱洞中透出浅色天空和远处楼房。成束吊索从塔体向外展开为长斜线，桥面横贯画面下半部并退向对岸。近处左前景的深色桁架、栏杆和阶梯挤成复杂的直线网络。宽阔河流位于桥后及桥下，以更安静的横向排线绘出；右侧水域颜色较深。河对岸，高层建筑紧密聚集，一栋叠着另一栋。屋顶线起伏不齐，几座显著的尖顶或退台高楼打破上方轮廓。小排窗户和结构分隔由耐心的线条反复刻画，但空气中的浅淡灰度柔化最远处楼体。绘画基本黑白，用密集交叉排线和点状暗色塑造桥梁及前景，再以更轻、更细的线条表现远处建筑。均匀日光带来宽泛、清楚的可读性，而非戏剧化阴影图案。视点足够高，可以同时看见桥面和河流，石塔仍主导中央结构。构图让桥梁精确的工程几何与密集、不规则的天际线节奏保持平衡，使整幅图既像精心测绘，又显得开阔。
style_prompt_en: Detailed monochrome pen work builds scale from countless short lines, crosshatched shadows, and repeated tiny structural marks. Firm diagonals and verticals establish a strong spatial framework; dense foreground blacks gradually relax into pale atmospheric linework in the distance. Windows, seams, cables, rails, and water texture are differentiated by stroke direction and spacing. The light is broad and neutral, so tonal density rather than color or spotlight gives the scene depth. A high oblique viewpoint allows layered near, middle, and far planes to remain simultaneously legible. The overall effect is patient, observational, and architecturally exact, with a hand-drawn surface always visible.
style_prompt_zh: 细密黑白钢笔笔触以无数短线、交叉排线阴影和重复的微小结构标记建立尺度。坚定斜线与竖线确立有力的空间骨架；浓黑前景逐渐松开为远方淡薄的空气线条。窗户、接缝、索线、栏杆和水面纹理由笔触方向与间距区分。光线宽泛中性，因此场景纵深来自色调密度而非色彩或聚光。较高的斜向视点让近、中、远层同时清楚可读。整体效果耐心、重观察、结构精确，手绘表面始终可见。
theme_en: A detailed pen drawing of a suspension bridge before a dense skyline
theme_zh: 密集城市天际线前的一座吊桥细密钢笔画
name: Stephen Wiltshire
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
